paragraphs: It's our honor to take part in such a wonderful program. We learned much more than we expected during the 5 weeks' study in Nagoya University Graduate School of Medicine.

Our rotation included 3 departments: Hematology, Geriatrics and Gastroenterology. All of them impressed us a lot. Every stuff of Nagoya University was considerate to us, giving thoughtful guidance in learning and daily life.

We wrote down our motivation and aim of taking this program at the beginning. With doctors and stuffs' help, we achieved each purpose and gained more than we imagined. Except professional knowledge we got, there are also many precious first time things for us happened, like witnessing the whole process of bone marrow transplantation, using endoscopes by ourselves, experiencing work schedules of Japanese doctors and so on, which are huge benefits for us.
We are grateful to everyone who had helped or taken care of us. And we hope you to be happy everyday.
